# [STORY] As a QA engineer, I want Playwright E2E tests driving the real Filmpire React app against the local stack, so that user journeys are verified end-to-end, not just at the unit/integration layer

## User Story
**As a** QA engineer
**I want** Playwright E2E tests driving the real Filmpire React app against the local stack
**So that** user journeys are verified end-to-end, not just at the unit/integration layer

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a real user journey is scripted in Playwright, when it runs against the local stack, then it exercises the app as a user experiences it (`e2e/tests/user-journeys.spec.js`, `cache-metrics.spec.js`, `auth-flow.spec.js`). CI has not confirmed a passing run yet: `.github/workflows/e2e-playwright.yml` fails before any scenario runs, because the job never starts the stack first (#320)
